ABOUT.TEXT: Full stack engineer and DevOps with 5 years of experience. I build web applications from end to end, from the screens people use to the cloud that runs them, and I make sure they stay fast, secure and reliable in production. I also create AI-powered solutions, with smart assistants that understand a business's own data and help its users get answers and make decisions faster.
